ai.title: CopilotKit Releases OpenBot 1.0: An MIT-Licensed, Self-Hostable AI Coworker With Built-In Governance
ai.brief: Most AI coworker products are vendor locked. They pick the model, host the data, and write the rules. CopilotKit is taking the opposite route. 0 , was released November 9th, an MIT-licensed , self-hostable agent workspace. What sets it apart is, a company brings their own models, agents and infrastructure. Governance is fully baked in, and every Bot action is checked against a policy before it runs. What is OpenBot? OpenBot is a modular agent workspace from CopilotKit , the team behind the AG-UI protocol. You give a Bot a task and watch it work. You review findings, interact with results and approve next steps in the same conversation. Each Bot gets a computer of its own . That is a container with its own Chromium browser, logins and files. It reaches only the tools you grant. Answers can come back as charts, checklists, tables and cards.
